question: Should OpenClaw expose generic progress intent through the public plugin SDK, or support Codex-specific progress symbols as permanent API?
rationale: This choice establishes a third-party compatibility contract across the SDK and two bundled plugins, so tests cannot determine the intended permanent boundary.

options.title: Generic progress intent
options.body: Expose a closed reusable progress contract and keep Codex-specific names private to the Codex plugin.

options.title: Codex-specific public API
options.body: Approve and maintain the current named symbols as supported plugin SDK surface.

recommendation.title: Generic progress intent
recommendation.body: Expose a closed reusable progress contract and keep Codex-specific names private to the Codex plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to the SDK, Codex projector, and Slack delivery boundaries involved in the choice.
